title: Revision of Electricity Market Structure and Its Impact on Singapore's Energy Security and Prices for Consumers
what_it_is: Revision of Electricity Market Structure and Its Impact on Singapore's Energy Security and Prices for Consumers

sections.label: Questions on electricity market changes
sections.summary: Questions asked the Minister for Trade and Industry about gas supply guardrails, retail licensee conduct, and stricter rules for energy retailers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry in relation to guardrails to ensure the security and adequacy of gas supply (a) whether this is expected to result in higher input costs and retail electricity prices; (b) what is the impact on the marginal cost of producing electricity in Singapore; and (c) what is the expected cost burden across the Government, generation companies and consumers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry following the Ministry's announcement at the Singapore International Energy Week Summit to revise the electricity market structure, what are the plans to update the Code of Conduct for Retail Electricity Licensees to strengthen retail consumer protection.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry in relation to the stricter rules for energy retailers to strengthen the existing market structure of Singapore's power sector (a) what are the specific enhanced regulatory requirements and tightened eligibility criteria to be introduced for better consumer protection; (b) what is the projected timetable for implementation of each area; and (c) whether there can be a prohibition on retailers prematurely terminating contracts with retail consumers.

sections.label: Centralised tender for generation capacity
sections.summary: EMA will introduce a centralised approach to facilitate investments in new generation through a competitive tender.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: First, to ensure that we continue to have sufficient generation capacity in time to come, EMA will introduce a centralised approach to facilitate investments in new generation through a competitive tender.

sections.label: Permanent measures for gas supply
sections.summary: Measures introduced late last year to safeguard energy security will be institutionalised as permanent features of the market.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Second, to safeguard energy security and enhance the resilience of our natural gas supply, we will institutionalise some of the measures that we had introduced late last year to safeguard energy security as permanent features of our market.

sections.label: Enhanced requirements for electricity retailers
sections.summary: Regulatory requirements on electricity retailers will be enhanced so they are better prepared and can withstand market volatilities.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim and Ms He Ting Ru have asked about our measures to strengthen the electricity retail market.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We will enhance the regulatory requirements imposed on electricity retailers, to ensure that they are sufficiently prepared and that they are better able to withstand market volatilities.

sections.label: Consumer options for electricity contracts
sections.summary: All consumers may enter retail contracts with electricity retailers, or households and small businesses may return to the regulated tariff.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: All consumers will continue to have the option of entering into retail contracts with electricity retailers, or, in the case of households and small business consumers, returning to the regulated tariff.

sections.label: Consultation and progressive implementation from 2023
sections.summary: EMA will consult industry and public on the enhancements, planning progressive implementation from 2023 onwards.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: EMA will consult the industry as well as the public on the details of these enhancements.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We plan to implement them progressively from 2023 onwards.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We welcome feedback and suggestions from Members of this House, the industry and members of the public on our enhancements.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: But the value of a more stable, secure and resilient energy system cannot be overstated.

sections.label: Gas supply mix and contract
sections.summary: The mix is probably about 60:40, or 40% LNG, and there is some drop from the new gas contract between GSPL and Medco.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: And the mix – I do not have it off-the-cuff today – I think that it is probably about 60:40, or 40% LNG.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: So, that drop from the new gas contract that was signed and entered into – I think that it was announced today – between Gas Supply Pte Ltd (GSPL) and MedcoEnergi (Medco), there is some drop.

sections.label: EMA consultation on retailer regulation
sections.summary: EMA will launch a consultation in the coming weeks on proposals to enhance regulatory measures for retailers and strengthen safeguards for affected consumers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Indeed, EMA will launch a consultation in the coming weeks on specific proposals to enhance some of these regulatory measures and requirements for retailers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: As part of the consultation, we will be releasing more details in the coming weeks.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We want to reassure the Member that in tightening regulatory requirements, EMA will also strengthen safeguards for consumers affected by exiting retailers, or even retailers who want to novate their agreements.

sections.label: Fair contracting practices for retailers
sections.summary: Retailers would be required to comply with fair contracting practices, providing consumers with the consumer advisory and fact sheets to summarise key terms.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: And particularly, I think three points to protect consumers that would be of interest to everyone here, in addition to Ms He.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: These include: one, requiring retailers to comply with fair contracting practices, such as providing consumers with the consumer advisory and fact sheets to summarise the key terms of their retail plans and consumers must acknowledge such information before signing contracts with the retailers.

sections.label: Refund of security deposits
sections.summary: Exiting retailers are required to refund all security deposits collected from household consumers, after offsetting outstanding charges.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Exiting retailers are required to refund all security deposits collected from household consumers, after offsetting outstanding charges.
